mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_log (user_id, question, answer, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{question}, #{answer}, #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' GROUP BY question ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT question FROM question_log WHERE question IS NOT NULL AND question <> '' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, user_id, question, answer, source, created_at, processed FROM question_log WHERE processed = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE question_log SET processed = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
